statement: PPN source projection must use T_total = T_material + T_EM + T_binding + T_parent_exchange_mapped.
impact: If T_parent_exchange_mapped=0, this is the ordinary GR total stress source.

statement: Maxwell stress is traceless but not gravitationally silent; its energy density and spatial stresses enter the PPN source integrals through T_total.
impact: This prevents the wrong move of ignoring EM because trace(T_EM)=0.

statement: The Lorentz force cancels between field and charged matter in total stress conservation; only parent exchange beyond this cancellation is a residual.
impact: This keeps EM from masquerading as WEP violation.

statement: Once same-source EM stress is parent-signed or residualized, gamma/beta need an explicit weak-field metric projection from T_total.
impact: This is the next PPN route.
